counterfactual_missing_items: Negative or within normal limits: antiribonucleoprotein, antihistone, antiphospholipid, anti-Smith, anti-Ro/Sjögren syndrome antigen A, and anti-La/Sjögren syndrome antigen B antibodies
No anti-desmoglein antibody testing is reported
decisive_items: Epidermal acanthosis, spongiosis, and acantholytic keratinocytes.
Granular and linear deposition of IgG and C3 at the basement membrane zone and abundant intercellular deposition of IgG and C3 in the upper two-thirds of the epidermis
response.rationale: R1 best explains the pemphigus-specific combination of acantholytic keratinocytes and intercellular IgG/C3 in the upper epidermis; the concurrent basement-membrane deposition and ANA positivity fit pemphigus erythematosus, a lupus-like pemphigus variant. C1 and R3 overfit the photodistributed rash and ANA but cannot account for acantholysis and intercellular DIF. R2 has no raw support and lacks muscle findings.

rejected.why: Its own raw support includes acantholysis and intercellular IgG/C3, which are pemphigus findings rather than lupus; negative anti-Ro/La/Smith and normal complement/ESR weaken SLE.
No raw support spans; photodistributed rash and ANA are nonspecific, and there are no muscle, heliotrope, or Gottron findings to support dermatomyositis.
